newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hilton estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hilton estimates raised.

text.p: McDonald & Co analyst Dennis Forst raised estimates for Hilton Hotels Corp based on strong lodging operations in the company's second quarter.
-- raised his estimate for the second quarter ending June 30, to $0.38 a share from $0.34 a share. Accordingly, his full year 1997 number went up to $1.38 a share from $1.34.
-- said in the lodging business, Hilton's revenue per available room (REVPAR) was up 10 to 12 percent.
-- said the gaming business was mixed.
-- said the Bally acquisition "is working out nicely."
